Using the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI data:

$$ \text{Adjusted Value} = \text{Original Amount} \times \left( \frac{\text{CPI}_{2022}}{\text{CPI}_{1939}} \right) $$
$$ \text{Adjusted Value} = \$500,000 \times \left( \frac{296.80}{14.0} \right) $$
